Easy Short Tour—Tenranzan Mountain

Discover the subtle changes in nature you might miss on an ordinary walk. Join our guide for a leisurely exploration of Tenranzan. This is a short, relaxed tour—come as you are.

【Fee】
¥2,000 per person; ¥1,500 for returning visitors; ¥4,000 per family (includes guide and insurance)

【Capacity】
10 people

【Guide】
Kojima Tsubasa (Hanno City Ecotourism Citizen Guides Association, Wildlife Section)

【What to bring】
Drink, rain gear, backpack or similar (something that keeps your hands free is best), towel, insect repellent spray

More information: https://hanno-tourism.jp/hanno-eco/tour/ec-chokotto-tenranzan/ (Hanno Ecotourism Association)
